name: duplicate_multilingual_event
description: Two fixed candidates in different languages describe the same urban-rail power incident.

candidates.title: Metro traction substation fault suspends Line 2
candidates.search_snippet: A traction substation fault suspended Line 2 during the morning peak.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic English incident report. On 17 September 2026, a traction substation fault at Central Section suspended Metro Line 2 during the morning peak. The operator isolated the substation and restored service after inspection.

candidates.title: 地鐵牽引變電站故障造成二號線停駛
candidates.search_snippet: 牽引變電站故障使二號線尖峰時段停駛，檢修後恢復服務。
candidates.source_content: Synthetic Chinese incident report. 2026年9月17日，中央區段牽引變電站發生故障，造成地鐵二號線尖峰時段停駛；營運商隔離變電站並完成檢查後恢復服務。

contract_notes: Candidate count is greater than event count after Event Identity merges the same factual event.
Both candidate IDs, the canonical source, supporting source, and claim provenance must remain traceable.
Language, URL, and title differences do not by themselves make different events.
